name: Arcadeous
subtitle: Own an arcade. Play every machine.
localizedDescription:
Own an arcade from minute one. Fill the floor with cabinets you can walk up to and actually play, set the ticket payout, stock the prize counter and keep the crowd coming back. A first-person arcade management sim where every machine is a real game.

• 59 playable cabinets: 50 coin-op games plus 9 ticket games, original games in the classic 1980s arcade style, drawn in real pixel art, including the fighter DOJO
• Ticket games, a prize counter and a prize wall of upgrades
• Where a machine sits changes what it earns: sightlines, walking routes and neighbours
• One new idea at a time: quarter games, then ticket games, then the ticket booth, then your own prize wall

iPhone beta: an on-screen controller (left thumb moves, drag right to look, tap to use; A B X Y in every cabinet).

versions.localizedDescription:
- A red pad says why. Moving or placing a machine on a red pad used to say only "something is in the way", even on open floor. It now says the reason: too close to a machine, keep the doorway clear, or customers could not reach a machine past it (the aisle in front of a row is where its players stand). (Thanks to the tester who sent this with /bug.)
- Change machines move again. The change machine's menu has MOVE THE CHANGE MACHINE, like every cabinet's. Before, the one you inherit could only be moved once, and a change machine you bought could never be moved. (Thanks to the tester who sent this with /bug.)
- Android tells the truth about your own music. The radio told Android players to drop mp3s in an iPhone folder. Android has no folder like that yet, so it now says the house stations play; the bug-report button points to /bug in our Discord. (Thanks to the tester who sent this with /bug.)
